summary: time confirmed reversal and read-only revenue/settlement pairing on BASE fa1ca8d. Added time-owned migration 0002_time_billable_reversal_guards without touching 0001: the BillableConfirmationReceipt action CheckConstraint now allows draft.save/confirm/reverse, and the dual-vendor guards were replaced so exactly one confirmed->reversed transition is allowed (version+1, confirmer/at and all business fields unchanged) while preserving draft edits, draft->confirmed, identity freezing, receipt immutability and no deletes. The PG guard is a single function with branches; SQLite keeps a single _update_guard trigger name (compatible with the existing PH-269 corruption probe) whose WHEN clause permits only the valid draft or reverse transitions. Added reverse_billable_confirmation(member, confirmation_id, *, reason, request_token, expected_version, dry_run=True): company lock, select_for_update(of=('self',)) because confirmed_by_member is nullable, only confirmed, creator cannot reverse their own confirmation (another owner/finance must), reason 1..500, expected_version, idempotent receipt action=reverse with replay/changed-input conflict and dry_run; the state changes status->reversed and version+1 in one transaction, writes generic audit time.billable_confirmation.reversed (reason/refs) and no canonical event/topic (the frozen spec explicitly has no reversed event), and writes no revenue, ledger, cash, cost or open-item fact. Added read-only billable_confirmation_pairing()/billable_confirmation_pairing_list(): confirmation ref/status/minutes, timesheet/contract-line refs, estimated confirmed value from the approved unit price, posted revenue count/net, active settlement count/gross, differences and paired/unpaired/partial state, with no writes or audit. Permissions: write owner/finance; read owner/finance/auditor; PM only managed projects; member denied; time module disabled still refuses writes while the list/detail routes are history_read and remain readable. UI: detail page with facts, read-only pairing and reverse form, plus list detail/reverse state. verify_integrity time branch extended: reversed rows require exactly one frozen confirmation-time canonical event (source version event=version-1), one reversal generic audit with matching refs/reason payload and one reverse receipt; confirmed rows must not carry a reversal audit; drafts must not carry reversal audit/event; the whole DB must not contain a time.billable_reversed.v1 canonical topic; receipt actions are limited to draft.save/confirm/reverse and reverse receipts must point at a reversed row. No global prohibition was added.
